proposals.what: Company Avatar: wire the Image boolean to the img layer
proposals.why: property exists but toggles nothing; instances needed a layer-visibility override

proposals.what: Alert: message text Fill instead of Hug; optional Show Close property
proposals.why: full-width alerts wrapped after a few words without an override; Builder handoff notice is dismissible

proposals.what: TextArea: Input frame Fill (or a height property) instead of fixed 98px
proposals.why: resizing the nested Input is ignored; overrides were needed for 40/72/100/124/140/212px textareas

proposals.what: Page title 32px DM Serif (Tracker, Builder input) and panel h2 26px are raw in code
proposals.why: code uses base h1/h2 sizes outside the type scale; Builder preview uses the H1 token, so the same title changes size between steps

proposals.what: Résumé section labels use text-transform: uppercase
proposals.why: design rules prohibit all-caps labels unless a canonical component specifies them
no highlight token; per-mode value would need a Theme variable

proposals.what: Date filter trigger is a button styled as a field
proposals.why: no field-trigger/button component; built from TextField for appearance

findings: Create vs edit forms order the same fields differently: Add Prospect puts Location/Employment/Work arrangement/Compensation under More job details; Prospect details shows them above it (T05/T06 vs T07).
Compensation range textarea is one row tall and clips multi-line retrieved values (T06).
captureNotes: Builder frames show "Log In" because Builder references were captured in a signed-out browser context; Tracker frames show the signed-in header except T01.
